matches.snippet: Applicant  Comments   Jake  Woodland  stated  the  facility  recycles  produced  water  and  uses  ponds  for  temporary   storage.   Public  Comments   Janice  Shipman  raised  concerns  regarding  mosquitoes,  wildlife,  evaporation,  and  air  quality.   Janet   Munson   asked   about   timelines   for   addressing   odor   or   issues.   Lynn   Moon   raised   concerns   regarding   odor,   prior   experience,   and   the   presence   of   H2S.   Motion   Commissioner  Reed  Van  Wagoner  moved  to  approve.   Seconded   by   Commissioner   Spencer   Turnbow.   Vote:   Unanimous.       Agenda  Item  A4   Conditional  Use  Permit  –  Solar  Power  Plant  (Vaibhav   Shree   LLC)   Staff  Presentation   Presented  by  Mike  Gottfredson.
